narr: A stationary frontal boundary interacting with a warm and humid airmass triggered scattered strong thunderstorms during the late morning and afternoon of August 30th. One of the cells dropped Doppler radar estimated rainfall of 1.5 to 2.5 in a short amount of time across eastern Clay County. As a result of the excessive rainfall rates, a road south of Camp Travis flooded.
ev: Big Four Road north of Angling Road was flooded.
lsr: WAYNE CO SHERIFF RECEIVED A REPORT THAT BIG FOUR ROAD NORTH OF ANGLING ROAD IS FLOODED.
